result_class_qualification: Candidate strengthened exact block theorem and explicit proof reduction; independent significance and novelty assessment pending.
theorem: For every separable quadratic global extension E/F and finite tuple of distinct nonzero parameters t_i disjoint from all conjugates, with t_i bar(t_i)!=1 in characteristic two, the simultaneous phase/boost group contains actual upper and lower nonidentity elementary matrices supported on each single block. Under the original division-algebra unitary hypotheses and exact additive-generation theorem, the enlarged group is exactly transitive on nonzero pairs.
original_hypotheses_preserved: L/k separable quadratic; D a central division L-algebra of odd degree n>=3 with unitary involution
E a star-stable maximal subfield Galois over L
Distinct nonzero conjugates t_i of d, with no t_i equal to any bar(t_j)
For the function-field application, E=LF as constructed in the manuscript and d bar(d) not in k, including in characteristic two
bounds_scope: One excluded-block kernel witness at a prescribed surviving block, not a bound for the final supported shear or additive generation.
exact_not_density: A double commutator is exactly identity on the excluded block.
A nonzero matrix entry is certified by a nonzero cubic and finite root avoidance.
Finite quotients of a finitely generated phase subring supply powers of an infinite-order phase congruent to one.
A normal-subgroup commutator is an actual nonidentity shear.
Commutators of normal-kernel lifts lie in their exact intersection.
The arithmetic local closures are followed by explicit lattice denominator clearing.
not_claimed: A counterexample to the manuscripts or a refuted manuscript assertion
A proof of either complete Margulis--Platonov main theorem
Formal verification of global arithmetic or manuscript pair-invariance
An independent Reviewer verdict or verified novelty

checks.requires: a*d != 0; x is a nonzero phase outside at most five roots

checks.counts: Boosts and simultaneous diagonal phases are generators; cancellation can only shorten the word.

checks.excluded_boundary: a*b=1 makes the degree-two map inseparable
